g.text: Collector cadence: median 61.882 ms (61.365–74.765 ms). Metric points use query midpoints; CPU uses averaging-interval midpoints.

g.text: Host/CUDA alignment: ±50.992 µs (half the origin-mark bracket). Host annotations do not establish GPU ownership or exclusive costs.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #172b4d

g.text: Transfers are completed bytes per bin, not instantaneous bandwidth. Coarse resource samples cannot resolve individual short phases; nulls remain gaps.

g.text: Nsight warns potentially missing NVTX events; all expected host phase ranges were validated. Other warnings remain in the report and manifest.
